u0: The agent is not at the exit and has not yet picked up the box. It must reach the exit to complete the task; picking up the box at some point is optional and would fulfill the preference. Reaching the exit without ever picking up the box still completes the required objective.
u1: The agent has picked up the box at some earlier point, so the optional try has been fulfilled. The remaining objective is to reach the exit, whether or not the box is still in hand. Once the agent reaches the exit, the task completes successfully.
u2: The agent has reached the exit cell, satisfying the required objective, and the episode ends successfully. The optional box pickup may have happened earlier or on reaching the exit, or it may not have happened at all, but it was not required for completion.
